entry.settingsNote: {{count}} saved account(s) in the switch list. Switching reloads permissions and menus.

sheet.title: Switch account
sheet.subtitle: Only accounts you chose to save appear here · up to {{max}}
sheet.expiredMeta: Not used for {{days}} days, login expired
sheet.rejectedMeta: Login no longer valid. Enter the password again
sheet.otherHostMeta: From another server. Enter the password again
sheet.addSubtitle: Log in with another username and password. Not saved by default
sheet.unsavedHint: Accounts that aren't saved need the password again after you switch away or log out.
sheet.rowHint: Tap to switch, long-press to remove from the list

remove.title: Remove from list?
remove.message: {{name}} will need the password again to switch back.

signOut.currentMessage: This ends the login on the server and removes the account from the switch list. The app then switches to the next account in the list, or goes back to the login screen if there isn't one.
signOut.allMessage: This clears the switch list, logs out the current account and goes back to the login screen.
signOut.settingsMessage: This phone has {{count}} more saved account(s) in the switch list.

blocked.onShiftMessage: Please clock out first, then switch.
blocked.busyMessage: Please finish what you're doing first.

confirmUnsaved.title: Switch account?
confirmUnsaved.message: {{name}} isn't saved in the switch list. Switching logs this account out, and you'll need the password to log in again.

add.title: Add account
add.intro: Once you log in, the app switches to the new account.
add.forgot: Forgot your password? You can still reset it with an email code on the login screen.
add.saveHelper: When ticked, you can switch to it from "Switch account". When unticked, it's a one-off login and you'll need the password again after switching away or logging out.
add.unsavedWarning: {{name}} isn't saved in the switch list and will be logged out when the new account logs in. You'll need the password again.
add.listFull: The switch list is full (max {{max}}). Remove one first, or untick to log in just this once.

relogin.title: Log in again as {{name}}
relogin.subtitleExpired: Saved login expired (not used for over 7 days)
relogin.subtitleRejected: Saved login is no longer valid
relogin.notice: If the server can't be reached, the account is kept and you'll just see "try again later". It's only marked as needing to log in again when the server rejects it (invalid login or restricted account).

overlay.title: Switching to {{name}}
overlay.stepClear: Stopping and clearing the current account's local data (cache / cart / picker)
overlay.hint: All input is blocked while switching, about 1–3 seconds

failures.needsRelogin: {{name}}'s login is no longer valid. Enter the password again.
failures.networkError: Can't reach the server. Please try again later.
failures.identityMismatch: The saved login for this account doesn't match the server. Log in again.
failures.vaultFull: The switch list is full (up to {{max}}). Remove one before saving another.
failures.activationFailed: The switch didn't finish. Log in again.
failures.sameAccount: That is already the current account.
failures.unknownAccount: This account is not in the list. Please add it again.
failures.notAccountSession: Account switching isn't available for this login type.
